description: This file defines the LocationValidator class, responsible for validating Location objects within the OpenMRS system. It checks for null values, duplicate names, circular parent relationships, field length constraints, and attribute validation.

classes.name: LocationValidator
classes.description: A validator class for Location entities, checking for proper field values, non-circular parent relationships, and duplication.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validation of the given object's class type, specifically Location.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a Location object, checking for null/empty fields, duplicates, circular parent references, and field length constraints.
